lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a structured grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid of high-luminance nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal edge and lower values on the ventral edge of each ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: An electronic tracking tag is attached to the distal portion of the first dorsal fin, featuring a dark-colored base and a thin, light-colored antenna extending vertically.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense population of small, high-intensity circular spots, significantly smaller and more concentrated than those on the lateral flank.
